parameters.value:
={{ $json.processedChunks.map(chunk => ({
  document_id: $json.documentId,
  customer_id: $json.customerId,
  widget_id: $json.widgetId,
  chunk_index: chunk.chunkIndex,
  content: chunk.content,
  embedding: `[${chunk.embedding.join(',')}]`,
  metadata: chunk.metadata,
  tokens_count: Math.ceil(chunk.content.length / 4),
  content_length: chunk.content.length
})) }}

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.value:
={{ {
  version: '2.0',
  textLength: $('Process Extracted Text').item(0).json.textLength,
  pageCount: $('Process Extracted Text').item(0).json.pageCount,
  wordCount: $('Process Extracted Text').item(0).json.wordCount,
  detectedLanguage: $('Process Extracted Text').item(0).json.detectedLanguage,
  extractionQuality: $('Process Extracted Text').item(0).json.extractionQuality,
  qualityMetrics: $('Process Extracted Text').item(0).json.qualityMetrics,
  chunkingQuality: $('Intelligent Document Chunking').item(0).json.chunkingQuality,
  processingTime: Date.now() - $('Parse Document Request').item(0).json.startTime
} }}
